documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Policies: Guidelines and Considerations
documents.stance_why: The page offers a menu of four sample syllabus statements ('Use prohibited', 'Use only with prior permission', 'Use only with acknowledgement', 'Use is freely permitted') and says 'standardized, one-size-fits-all policies are neither sustainable nor reflective'. It sets no stance itself beyond the Community Standard's ban on 'unauthorized' use, so it delegates with tiers.
tiers: Use is freely permitted with no acknowledgement
documents.summary: The Duke CTL guide for writing syllabus AI policies. It states the Community Standard baseline, urges every instructor to set a course policy, gives rationales and example policies from other institutions, four sample tiers, and advice against AI detection software.
